## Design

### 2026-10-12 – October 12th: DockWall

**3h**

October 12th: DockWall

CAD. CAD is something I have learned and know a decent amount but my knowledge is surface level. Through this project, first I thought of building something cool like a marble course(starter guide) or a 3D dragon. But, I have realized I could solve a major issue of mine. Organization. So after hours of searching I found the iconic IKEA Skadis.

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 201402](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/2bd8651030afa47b716bd802b46890ade9d6c58bd5914813e75f5ef05506e5d1.png)

I measured the bookshelf space where I wanted it to go and realized it had perfect 2:3 ratio for me to make 6 240mmx240mm boards. I searched up measurements for the pegs and made it in Fusion.

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 201428](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/c1ef87f2c95345f2c22c33dc96197dfc9a55a11c26a49841a18721b21c1cff4f.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 201329](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/4b414683e959bdc7b6012e55c66a2711f39ef6a59d58653c7179c0aa0b9c5a70.png)

The only problem I have is I don't really want to drill the pegboard on to my bookshelf. It would be the last resort if I have to, but for now I am thinking of ways how to attach my board and make it stable without that.

### 2026-10-13 – October 13th: Connection Figured Out!

**3h**

October 13th: Connection Figured Out!

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 220646](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/175e128e448d05d4adb5d970c20e3c813c8fe93bc146830a6704f735e8ccf168.png)

This pretty sums up why it took 3 hours. Every time I changed or added something in Fusion it would take a minute  to load or crash. Great...

I first designed the connection I was going to make with the bookshelf with the DockWall with a drill but my parents said no. So I scrapped that whole idea and the design I already made. Forgot to take a screen shot but it looked like this.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/4065fa9ee77af8ce68e5be341735d2901b372e7dedbece58e601bae39715cbee.png)

Using thread I made this on each corners, but since that can't work, I brainstormed and thought of just using 3D pieces to connect the boards.

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 222634](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/b9bf6e4be725c208586019919a590f912ede84046eabfa1068afeb93c62d7bde.png)

Didn't make much progress but I have all the basic setup.
